user.title: Add OXRS Touch Panel
user.description: Enter the panel's MQTT client id (shown on the panel's Settings screen).

confirm.title: OXRS Touch Panel discovered
confirm.description: Do you want to add the panel "{name}"?

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery message could not be parsed.
abort.not_oxrs_touchpanel: The discovered device is not an OXRS Touch Panel.

add_tile.title: Add a tile
add_tile.description: Choose which screen to add the tile to.

data.label: Label
data.sublabel_entity_id: Sub-label source (optional) - shows this entity's state under the tile
data.indicator_secondary_entity_id: Secondary sensor (optional, indicator tiles only) - shown alongside the primary value

add_tile_playlists.title: Add a tile — choose playlists
add_tile_playlists.description: Tick up to {max} Music Assistant playlists. They appear in the tile's list on the panel, and choosing one replaces the player's queue with it.

name_screen.title: Name this screen
name_screen.description: Give screen {screen} a name, or keep the current one. This appears as the screen's label on the panel.

rename_screen.title: Rename a screen
rename_screen.description: Choose a screen and enter its new name.

add_background_image.title: Add background image
add_background_image.description: Generate a base64 image string using the OXRS Asset Generator at https://oxrs.io/tools/asset-generator.html then paste the imageBase64 value below. This image becomes available on every configured panel. Images must be under 4 KB and names cannot start with an underscore.

data.image_name: Image name (used to reference this image on tiles)
data.image_base64: Base64 image string (paste from OXRS Asset Generator)

delete_background_image.title: Delete a background image
delete_background_image.description: Choose an image to remove from the shared library. Any tile still referencing it (on any panel) will simply stop receiving it next time that panel's configuration is pushed.

add_custom_icon.title: Add custom icon
add_custom_icon.description: Generate a base64 PNG using the OXRS Asset Generator at https://oxrs.io/tools/asset-generator.html (change addImage to addIcon in its output) then paste the imageBase64 value below. This icon becomes available on every configured panel, grouped by category in the icon picker. Icons must be PNG, under 4 KB, and names cannot start with an underscore.

data.icon_name: Icon name (used to reference this icon on tiles)
data.icon_base64: Base64 PNG string (paste from OXRS Asset Generator)

delete_custom_icon.title: Delete a custom icon
delete_custom_icon.description: Choose an icon to remove from the shared library.

abort.no_tiles: There are no tiles to remove.
abort.screen_full: That screen has no free tile positions. Choose another screen or remove a tile first.
abort.invalid_tile_style: Please select a valid tile style.
abort.invalid_format: Error selecting tile format. Check the logs for details.
abort.invalid_type: Error selecting tile type. Check the logs for details.
abort.invalid_details: Error setting tile details. Check the logs for details.
abort.no_file: Please paste the base64 image string.
abort.image_error: Invalid base64 string. Copy the imageBase64 value from the OXRS Asset Generator output.
abort.image_too_large: Image is larger than 64 KB. Resize it first - the OXRS docs call ~4 KB safe, and larger images may not draw at all.
abort.invalid_image_name: Image name cannot start with an underscore.
abort.image_uploaded: Background image saved to the shared library - available on every panel!
abort.no_screens: No screens exist yet — add a tile first.
abort.image_deleted: Background image deleted from the shared library.
abort.no_images: There are no background images in the shared library yet.
abort.icon_uploaded: Custom icon saved to the shared library - available on every panel!
abort.icon_deleted: Custom icon deleted from the shared library.
abort.no_icons: There are no custom icons in the shared library yet.
abort.music_assistant_unavailable: Couldn't read the Music Assistant library for this player. Check that Music Assistant is running, then try again.
abort.no_playlists: The Music Assistant library has no playlists yet. Add some in Music Assistant, then try again.

error.image_error: Invalid base64 string. Copy the imageBase64 value from the OXRS Asset Generator output.
error.image_too_large: Too large - the encoded string must stay under 64 KB. The OXRS docs call ~4 KB safe; above that the panel may ignore the image or restart.
error.invalid_image_name: Name cannot start with an underscore (reserved for built-ins).
error.icon_must_be_png: Custom icons must be PNG format.
